headline: What Mistakes Should I Avoid When Updating My Kitchen?
articleBody:
Embarking on a kitchen renovation in Las Vegas is exciting, but it’s easy to stumble into common pitfalls. Knowing what to watch out for can save you a ton of stress, time, and money. 

One big mistake is rushing the planning phase. Seriously, don't skimp on this! We’ve seen projects where folks dive in without a clear vision, leading to costly changes mid-way. Take your time to really visualize your ideal kitchen, considering functionality, aesthetics, and your daily routine. 

Another common one is underestimating the budget. Unexpected issues pop up, especially in older homes. Always set aside a contingency fund – maybe 10-15% of your total budget – for those 'just in case' moments. Also, don't just focus on the flashy stuff; remember the costs of plumbing, electrical, and demolition.
